name: Cyber Security Awareness Training
summary:
Information security and cybersecurity are increasingly important topics relevant to all who work with IT. With Cyber Security Awareness Training you can learn about both physical and digital threats and test your ability to detect risks around the office. Challenge your friends or colleagues in time limited scenarios and see who will get the best scores. 

Make IT security fun, engaging and competitive! 

This version of Cyber Security Awareness Training is for private users. For organizations and business
